```{r}
#Set working directory
setwd("/Users/cmdb/qb26-answers/week1")

# Load Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#create dataframes
header <- c( "chr", "start", "end", "count" )
df_19 <- read_tsv( "hg19-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )
df_16 <- read_tsv( "hg16-kc-count.bed", col_names=header )

#Create combined dataframe
df_merge <- bind_rows(hg19=df_19, hg16=df_16, .id= "assembly")
```

ggplot

```{r}

library(dplyr)

#remove the chrMT and chrM
df_merge_new <- df_merge %>%
  filter(!chr %in% c("chrM", "chrMT"))

df_merge_new %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=start, y=count, color=assembly))+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~chr, scales="free")+
  labs(
    x= "Position",
    y= "Count", 
    caption = "Note: scales are not the same in X or Y!"
  )+
  theme_classic()
#Save plot as png
ggsave("exercise2.png", width = 20, height =8)
```
